segments.an3.105:1.1: “No cedaṃ [no cetaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.) saṃ. ni.3.28 passitabbaṃ], bhikkhave, loke assādo abhavissa, nayidaṃ sattā loke sārajjeyyuṃ.
segments.an3.105:1.2: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, atthi loke assādo, tasmā sattā loke sārajjanti.
segments.an3.105:1.3: No cedaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ādīnavo abhavissa, nayidaṃ sattā loke nibbindeyyuṃ.
segments.an3.105:1.4: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, atthi loke ādīnavo, tasmā sattā loke nibbindanti.
segments.an3.105:1.5: No cedaṃ, bhikkhave, loke nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa, nayidaṃ sattā lokamhā [loke (ka.)] nissareyyuṃ.
segments.an3.105:1.6: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, atthi loke nissaraṇaṃ, tasmā sattā lokamhā nissaranti.
segments.an3.105:1.7: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, sattā lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsuṃ [nābbhaññaṃsu (saṃ. ni.3.28], neva tāva, bhikkhave, sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā [vippayuttā (ka.)] vimariyādīkatena [vimariyādikatena (sī. pī. ka.)] cetasā vihariṃsu.
segments.an3.105:1.8: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, sattā lokassa assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsuṃ, atha, bhikkhave, sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharantī”ti.
